description:
Title: Becoming A Parent

Create a process that support in planning, taking and extending a maternity leave.  
* Fetch information about potential models (months duration, split between parents) 
* Let parent select 
* Collect relevant information 
* Notify Social Security, Company in time 
* Gather information from companies 
* At the end of the period let parent decide about extension.

<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_BecomingAParent" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/becoming-a-parent">
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_BecomingAParent" name="Becoming A Parent">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Parent" name="Parent" processRef="Process_BecomingAParent"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_SocialSecurity" name="Social Security"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Company" name="Company"/>

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_NotifyCompanyExt" name="Extension notification" sourceRef="Task_NotifyCompanyExtension" targetRef="Participant_Company"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_BecomingAParent" name="Becoming A Parent" isExecutable="false">

    </bpmn:startEvent>

      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_NotifySplit" name="Notify parties">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_5</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_6</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_NotifySocialSecurity" name="Notify Social Security in time">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_7</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_NotifyCompany" name="Notify Company in time">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_6</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_8</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_NotifyJoin">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_7</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_8</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_9</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_GatherCompanyInformation" name="Gather information from companies">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_9</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_10</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_LeavePeriodEnds" name="Leave period ends">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_10</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_11</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ExtensionDecision" name="Extend leave?" default="Flow_13">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_11</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_12</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_13</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CollectExtensionInformation" name="Collect extension information">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_12</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_14</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ExtensionSplit" name="Notify parties of extension">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_14</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_15</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_16</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_NotifySocialSecurityExtension" name="Notify Social Security of extension">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_15</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_17</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_NotifyCompanyExtension" name="Notify Company of extension">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_16</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_18</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ExtensionJoin">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_17</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_18</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_19</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_LeaveExtended" name="Leave extended">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_19</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_LeaveCompleted" name="Leave completed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_13</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="Start_PlanLeave" targetRef="Task_FetchLeaveModels"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_FetchLeaveModels" targetRef="Task_SelectLeaveModel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="Task_SelectLeaveModel" targetRef="Task_CollectInformation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="Task_CollectInformation" targetRef="Gateway_NotifySplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="Gateway_NotifySplit" targetRef="Task_NotifySocialSecurity"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" sourceRef="Gateway_NotifySplit" targetRef="Task_NotifyCompany"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7" sourceRef="Task_NotifySocialSecurity" targetRef="Gateway_NotifyJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_8" sourceRef="Task_NotifyCompany" targetRef="Gateway_NotifyJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_9" sourceRef="Gateway_NotifyJoin" targetRef="Task_GatherCompanyInformation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Task_GatherCompanyInformation" targetRef="Event_LeavePeriodEnds"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Event_LeavePeriodEnds" targetRef="Gateway_ExtensionDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" name="Extension requested" sourceRef="Gateway_ExtensionDecision" targetRef="Task_CollectExtensionInformation">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${extensionRequested == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" name="No extension" sourceRef="Gateway_ExtensionDecision" targetRef="End_LeaveCompleted"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Task_CollectExtensionInformation" targetRef="Gateway_ExtensionSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="Gateway_ExtensionSplit" targetRef="Task_NotifySocialSecurityExtension"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" sourceRef="Gateway_ExtensionSplit" targetRef="Task_NotifyCompanyExtension"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" sourceRef="Task_NotifySocialSecurityExtension" targetRef="Gateway_ExtensionJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_18" sourceRef="Task_NotifyCompanyExtension" targetRef="Gateway_ExtensionJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_19" sourceRef="Gateway_ExtensionJoin" targetRef="End_LeaveExtended"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
